ic.label: Total costs related to goods produced and sold during the reporting period, excluding depreciation and amortization expense.

The aggregate total costs related to selling and distributing a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. Distribution expenses are expenses associated with the distribution of the firm's products and services, including labor and overhead associated with warehousing and delivery. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.
